nom: Drunk Elephant Mello Marula Cream Cleanser

avis.texte: I have dry, mature skin. I was a little worried whether this cleanser would remove makeup and sunscreen, but it worked really well! I even used on vacation to shave my legs. Overall very pleased with this product!
I love Drunk Elephant products but was disappointed in this cleanser. It didn't provide the results I expected. It didn't remove my makeup.

avis.titre: Great for all skin types especially sensitive skin
avis.texte: This cleanser is awesome! I have sensitive skin and redness issues with my skin. This cleanser is so gentle my skin is not red after washing and feels great. I highly recommend this product.
Broke me out into tiny bumps. One of the few DE products that my skin hated
This is a miracle cleanser. I originally bought this just to try but fell in love with it. I ended up buying more products because of how well this works.

I love the creamy texture of this cleanser and how it lathers up to a rich comforting foam that leaves my skin feeling clean but not stripped. I also really like the natural scent of the colloidal oatmeal.

avis.titre: My new go-to cleanser - it's a dream!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleanser. I used the Beste for many years and loved it, but this is my new favorite. I'm 51 so I appreciate how this is not drying at all but still effective. It feels great. I usually put some in my hands, add a tiny bit of water and massage it into my face. Then I add more water to my hands and when I rub them over my face it starts to get a gentle lather, then I rinse. I am extremely scent-sitive so I appreciate its mild but pleasant smell. The issue with unscented products is that often they just smell gross (to me). Clearly whatever is naturally in the product smells pleasant. It would take a lot to get me to even try another cleanser at this point. The ONLY thing it doesn't seem to do well is remove waterproof mascara, but realistically very few cleansers do.

I have been an avid Dermalogica Ultracalming Cleanser girl for years now. I ran out and decided to try something new and omg has this been incredible. I get redness around my nose and cheeks normally but even more now that I wear a CPAP mask and this has helped to reduce that redness. I do my double cleanse and feel great after. Doesn't leave your face feeling tight and hasn't dried me out as someone who already has dry skin.
I have eczema over my face especially in the winter, but this product is INCREDIBLY gentle on skin. I am super picky with what goes on my body and I don't usually leave reviews, but this is THE one.

avis.titre: First cleanser to actually calm my breakouts and rosacea!
avis.texte: I usually don't write reviews but this cleanser is seriously AMAZING i need to tell everyone about it. I have acne prone- combination skin and i suffer from A LOT of roseasea on my cheeks. I started using this product only 3 days ago and my acne is GONE and my redness is clearing up. I pair this with nivea cream jn the tin. Amazing combo!!! I am SO pleased with the results.
My current go to preferred facial cleanser -- I like the creamy texture and moisturizing quality.
I do not like the smell and my face does not feel clean after use.
Honestly, which it was scented - maybe it's the faint smell of the oatmeal. Love the froth! Competitor products are more affordable, just saying. Clinique, Origins are comparable.
I absolutely love this cleanser! There is no stripping of the skin at all and the light scent is incredible!!
great for sensitive skin, very gentle, only thing is that the smell of it isn't my favorite but i enjoy that it is so gentle!

avis.titre: Perhaps not the best for dry skin
avis.texte: This is a nice cleanser, but it doesn't leave my face a comfortable as I'd like. It feels tight and dry, and a little itchy/sting-y. It feels immediately when I apply my smoothy, so it all works out, but ultimately I'd prefer something a little more soothing.

I've been using these products for 5 years now and was never all that impressed with the face washed up to this point. I loved all the other parts of my facial routine so I didn't mind using another brand cleanser. But this new cream cleanser is amazing! My pores feel clean (the others from DE left my pores feeling clogged after washing) but not stripped or dry. And it actually removes my waterproof mineral sunblock so I don't have to use two separate steps to wash after a day at the beach or pool.

I was looking for a good cream cleanser for my dry sensitive skin, i saw this cleanser had oatmeal and good lipids for your skin which i appreciate, it has a good lather - not too foamy, it washed off well BUT not sure what, i only used it for 2 days and i see little break outs coming in under my nose and chin. Oddly enough, i had a feeling it would break me out knowing my skin, i gave it a chance but nope! And the smell…why does it need fragrance? Tbh, sorry DE but it made me wanna barf. I returned this item.

avis.titre: This will be a regular purchase!
avis.texte: Love this gentle cleanser! Skin is not at all dry after using this. Will keep this in stock at all times!
I am on my second bottle. It is a large size and lasts a long time. I have very sensitive skin and had trouble finding a cleanser that didn't cause irritation. This has been a great choice.
I use this in the mornings. Im usually not a cream cleanser fan because they dont seem to make my face clean. This is different. My face not only feels clean, but also is soft and not dried out.

I have roseacea (derm diagnosed) and this helps lessen the redness. I use as step two of two part cleaning and my skin feels clean, moisutrized and not tight. My husband even likes using it. Will forever repurchase.

I have exclusively used drunk elephant products for about two years, including the Marula Oil. After the first use of this cleanser, my skin started burning and broke out in a rash that covered my face, nose, and eyelids. I will never use it again.

This is the best cleanser I've ever used. This is perfect for dry skin. The texture is creamy, silky smooth, and lightweight. I love the subtle oatmeal scent as well. My skin immediately feels softer after rinsing. My previous cleanser broke me out on a regular basis, but I rarely ever get breakouts now after starting using this cleanser.

I got a little sample from Ulta and I really like using this product so I will be buying soon. Leaves my skin feeling so soft and removes everything sunscreen, make up etc. it's pricey but it's worth it to me

I recently received a deluxe sample of this in a GWP and I honestly had not even planned on trying it. I have tried many Drunk Elephant products and really wanted to like them but just found them mediocre. When it comes to skincare I am more of a Dermalogica and Lancome girl. Well I ended up getting a pretty intense chemical peel last week and my skin was pretty raw. I remembered that I had this sample and that it had colloidal oatmeal in it so I decided to try it out in lieu of my usual cleansing balm. I was pleasantly surprised when I felt the texture, creamy and smooth, a small amout goes a long way! It felt soothing on my irritated skin and when I added water it gently transformed into a light foaming cleanser. It did a great job removing my makeup and left my skin feeling refreshed. I did follow it up with my usual Lancome Confort cleanser but I really don't think it was even necessary as the Mello cleanser did a fantastic job all on its own. I have already ordered the full size and it will now be a staple in my nightly skincare routine!
I love this cleanser! I have sensitive skin and this stuff cleans my skin while not being overly harsh. I love the way it feels on my skin. Will be repurchasing!
It removes makeup well I double cleanse if I wear heavy makeup but it doesnt strip the skin, helped me with texture and it doesnt break me out.

avis.titre: Best face wash for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Smells amazing, feels amazing, leaves skin clean and moisturized. It has toned down my eczema symptoms dramatically and offered so much relief to my sensitve skin. Can't say enough good things about this face wash. I absolutely love it!

I was super excited to try this product as I heard great things about it. The first night I used it , my face felt super soft. But, as I kept using it throughout the week, I noticed my face kept getting itchy and as of yesterday, I have completely stopped using this product as I have broken out in a rash.

I was super excited to try this product as I heard great things about it. The first night I used it , my face felt super soft. But, as I kept using it throughout the week, I noticed my face kept getting itchy and as of yesterday, I have completely stopped using this product as I have broken out in a rash.
I have combination skin with rosacea. I bought this to see if it would help with a flare up. The cleanser isn't bad but it dries my skin out and makes it itch. Not for me.

The product does the job, it removes makeup and spf but the back of the product claims its ok to use in the eye area. DO NOT USE IT FOR YOUR EYE MAKEUP. I only put a little under my eyes to remove concealer and it burns your eyes bad. Not go mention this product is extremely overpriced for a makeup cleanser there are so many better and more affordable options

avis.titre: I usually don't fall in love with a face wash
avis.texte: Normally, if it doesnt dry me out I'm happy. I have never been moved by a face wash until now.

I got a sample of this product with an order recently. I've used it two or three times and my breakout just gets worse each time. In the past I have tried this (or a similar Drunk Elephant cleanser) years ago with the same result. I had to check that it was actually a cleanser because it really just felt like cream melting into my skin. It smells nice but I can't continue using it. I'm 35, have very fair combination skin and minimal issues with breakouts when I use the right cleanser (Cetaphil, Origins).

avis.titre: You need this product in your life
avis.texte: I recently purchased this product to try and have a cleaner skin care routine. After a couple of days of using this product, my skin felt the smoothest and healthiest it has in a while. Obsessed is an understatement!

I have tried every cleanser from Evan Healy, Mad Hippie, and Earth Harbor in a quest to find something with natural ingredients and no animal testing that doesn't dry out my now middle-aged skin or aggravate my middle-age rosacea. Nothing was gentle enough. This is. As soon as I tried it, my skin just relaxed. It cleans well, also. Even my husband is enthusiastic about it (and he never cares about skin care products, so that's a rave review). Love the light smell that dissipates quickly (reminds me of marshmallow).

I am so shovked at how amazing this cleanser is! I have dry sensitive skin and sometimes get eczema on my face. This has been such a light soothing cleanser its calmed down my redness and i cannot be happier! Its truly as good as everyone says! So happy with this purchase!
I purchased this on my own. I have dry to very dry sensitive skin. This is one of the only cleansers I've used that doesn't leave my face feeling stripped. Thank you DE!!!
Thick, creamy, smells lovely, and has a rich lather to it that calms my rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis without irritating my dry, sensitive, acne-prone skin. Overall, this is my dream cleanser.
Great cleanser that's not harsh on my skin. Easily removed makeup. And leaves a refreshing feel.

Wasnt sure if it would remove everything given the colloidal oatmeal tends to be for more soothing/sensitive skin. But it does! Very gentle but effective and I definitely do not feel like my skin is stripped after use. Breaks down my makeuo with one cleanse.
Ohhh man! This is a great face wash! I have been using Beste No 9 for years. This one is very creamy and leaves your face very clean and soft without stripping it. I would recommend.

avis.titre: I wouldn't recommend this if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: I dont know why, but after using the Mellow Marula cream cleanser, I developed a terrible rash on my chest and behind my ears. I didn't realize that the rash was caused by this stuff until i stopped using it (i used it twice a day for three days). Its been almost 36 hours since i last used this cleanser ans the rash is like 96% gone. So, if you have sensitive skin, I would suggest skipping this cleanser.

I love the subtle exfoliating yet moisturizing feel of this face wash!! My favorite D.E facewash and I have tried them all. My face never feels tight when I use this. Best thing I have bought in a while.
For some reason the smell of this product before i even used it was a huge turn off. Then when i put it on my face to try it out the product was so thin i needed a lot of it to feel anything.

I never saw myself as a Drunk Elephant user as the brand is overpriced and I associate it with preteen girls. I received a sample of this cleanser and to my surprise, my dry/sensitive skin loved it. I ended up purchasing the full size. This cleanser is creamy and thick with a light lather. There is a slight scent from the oatmeal but it's calming. Looking forward to using this all winter!

I received a sample from Ulta. I don't usually use cream cleansers but I really like this. It feels very gentle and didn't dry out my skin. I'm very sensitive to smells and I like the subtle sweet smell, almost like marshmallows. It doesn't linger, so once you rinse your face the smell is gone. There's no "fragrance" listed and the scent is from natural origin, which I love! Overall I'll probably end up buying the full size product.

Love the Mello Marula Cream Cleanser! Gifted By Drunk Elephant. Gentle on my sensitive skin, yet effectively removes makeup and impurities. Leaves my skin feeling soft, calm, and balanced. Highly recommend!

I love this cleanser, it works so good. I have very dry and sensitive skin, prone to redness. This leaves my skin feeling so hydrated and smooth, I have more of an even skin tone with less redness and I love it. It lathers and rinses off great. Gifted by drunk elephant

I'm not usually a cream cleanser gal, but I loved this one! It does a perfect job cleansing without stripping my dry skin, but doesn't leave residue like some creamy cleansers can. Very gentle, but effective. Love that it's unscented but has a pleasant natural milky aroma. I use this inbetween exfoliating cleanses & the colloidal oatmeal really soothes my skin. Highly recommend for sensitive/irritated skin! *Gifted by drunkelephant

I recently tried the Drunk Elephant Mello Marula Cream Cleanser, and I really liked it. The texture is smooth and creamy, which feels nice on the skin. It does a great job of removing makeup and dirt without making my skin feel dry. After using it, my face feels soft and clean. I think it's a great choice for anyone wanting a gentle cleanser. gifted by drunk elephant.

Gifted by drunk elephant. This cleanser is amazing on my dry skin. It removes makeup and impurities without making my face feel very dry after each use. The only thing I was not a fan was the smell of the cleanser.

A very gentle cleanser that really works removing everything. It lathers up really nicely. I use it twice a day and it never leaves my skin dry, it is actually hydrating. Love it. Gifted by drunk elephant.

Very gentle cleanser. It does not lather much, but still leaves my skin feeling clean but not stripped. It removes impurities from my skin, but leaves my skin still hydrated after use. This cleanser is perfect for my skin in the winter because my skin is extra dry and irritated. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

If you're looking for a good cream cleanser for winter DE has it right here! I like to swap to a more creamy moisturizing cleanser for the drier season and this didn't disappoint. I received this complimentary from Drunk Elephant in exchange for my honest review!

This cleanser is incredible. It's both a makeup remover and a foaming cleanser. My makeup melted off and my skin was so clean even though I didn't double cleanse. My face felt moisturized and didn't look dry after cleaning which it usually does since most cleanser strips my face of oils. I was gifted by Drunk Elephant.

This is a really gentle and hydrating cream cleanser. It's great for when I have irritated skin due to over exfoliation. It doesn't lather much. Would need to double cleanse to make sure I get all the makeup and oil off my skin. Gifted by Drunkelephant

Oooh i LOVED this cleanser! It worked so well! I love the ease of the container so i can take it with me of needed, it smells great, and it cleans my face beautifully. It left my skin soft and glowing. It didn't give it that over dry feeling, just left it feeling clean and ready for my skincare routine. *Gifted by Drunk Elephant

Gifted by Drunk elephant. I have been wanting a cleanser that suits my dry and sensitive skin. I really like this one especially because it doesn't dry out my skin or cause any sensitivity flare up. Great product

This cleanser is just what my skin needed in the colder dry weather! I LOVE how soothing and pampering it is on my skin, while cleaning the skin so well. Removes dirt and makeup like a dream! Although it's a creamy cleanser, it lathers beautifully, and leaves the skin feeling so baby soft and nourished! Gifted by drunk elephant

I'm loving this cleanser from Drunk Elephant. It has a creamy, lightweight texture and is fragrance free. It lathers well and only a small amount is needed. It gets off all my makeup with no problem and makes my face feel squeaky clean. Afterwards my skin feel so soft and refreshed, and i like how gentle it is on my skin. It's one of my favorite cleansers! I was gifted this product complimentary from Drunk Elephant.

I received this product for free, in exchange for an honest review. I haven't tried too many products from this brand, but I've really been enjoying this cleanser. It's very gentle and I prefer cream cleansers like this one. There's no scent that I notice, and I really like how my skin looks and feels after washing my face with this. I'd definitely be interested in seeing more products in this line! Complimentary from Drunk Elephant

I love this cleanser! It smells amazing and leaves my face feeling so clean. My blackheads have gotten much better since using this cleanser. I use it at night and a lighter cleanser in the morning. I would buy this again! Gifted by drunkelephant.

Ps: gifted by drunkenelephant Drunk Elephant Mellow Marula Cream Cleanser is a solid, gentle cleanser that's well-suited for sensitive or dry skin. It has a creamy, smooth texture that doesn't strip the skin, leaving it feeling hydrated and soft after use. The formula is fragrance-free, which is a plus for those who are sensitive to scents. It includes Marula oil, which is known for its moisturizing and antioxidant properties, and it does a good job of removing light makeup and impurities without causing irritation. However, while it's effective for daily cleansing, it may not be strong enough for removing heavy makeup or sunscreen in one go. You may need a double cleanse if you're wearing heavier products. The price point is on the higher end for a cleanser, especially considering that there are similar products available at lower prices.

This marula cream cleanser is gentle and effective. The creamy texture feels so good on the skin; for me, it's almost like a spa experience at home. It removes dirt, makeup, and excess oil without leaving my skin feeling dry. It has marula oil that leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated after every use. The fragrance-free formula making it perfect for sensitive skin, and I love how it works nicely with the rest of my skincare routine. Gifted by drunkelephant.

This cleanser is great if you want something that cleanses but doesn't dry out your skin. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean but without that tightness. It's pretty pricey for a cleanser. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

Gifted by drunk elephant for my honest review and thoughts. This cream cleanser has been so perfect for my skin this winter. I have pretty sensitive skin and this cleanser helps clean without irritating or drying me out

I absolutely loved this cleanser. I feel like it's actually broke up all the makeup on my skin and didn't completely burn my eyes when I used it to takeoff eye makeup like other ones tend to do. I highly recommend it gifted by a drunk elephant.

My skin has been feeling so dehydrated lately and any cleanser I have makes it feel stripped. This cleanser is so gentle yet effectively removes all makeup and leaves my skin feeling soothed. A little goes a long way! Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

This is a very nice gentle cleanser but nothing special in my opinion and I say this because I've tried very similar ones to this that are cheaper. Either way, nothing wrong about it, it does the job! Gifted by drunkelephant

I am amazed with Drunk Elephant and its products from the start. It's very rewarding to be able to try this new Mello Marula cream cleanser. It's rich in antioxidants which makes my skin look so good and gives me the perfect glowing skin. It a great cleanser because it doesn't strip away my skin's moisture but it made my skin soft, smooth and hydrated. It's worth every penny. Gifted by drunkelephant

I like that this cleanser is really clean. It's somewhere between feeling milky and jelly and consistency. Afterwards, my skin feels fairly hydrated, normally after washing my face, it becomes super dry, so I was pleased at the hydrating properties. gifted by drunk elephant

I am usually very prepared to give a "nice, but not worth the money" review on cleansers when I get them gifted but this one SHOCKED me. It is unlike anything I've tried before I can not believe how soothing and softening (but still melts away make up?) this is. 100% percent you need it especially if you have dry or sensitive skin. Loved it, will 100% but again! Gifted by drunk elephant

I love how gentle the cleanser is and how my face feels so plump and soft afterwards. It removes the remainder of my makeup well and has such a clean and pleasant smell! I have sensitive skin and when I switched to this cleanser, I didn't experience any irritation! You also don't have to use a ton of product to clean your face. I absolutely would recommend! Gifted by drunkelephant

I am really enjoying this product! My skin is dry so I love a creamy cleanser. This product gets all the makeup off my face and leaves me with a clean hydrated face. I don't mind that it doesn't have a super big lather. It works perfect for me! Gifted by drunk elephant

Gifted by drunkelephant Using this cleanser before I go to don't matter if I wear make up or not, makes my skin so soft and moisturized. I don't need to double cleanse when I use it. My skin always feels soft the next day. One of the best cleanser

This product was gifted by DrunkElephant in exchange for my honest review. I have a dry, sensitive skin so when it comes to skin care I'm very picky. And this cleanser matches my expectations - it's not overly fragranced, doesn't make my skin feel tight or dry. Cleanses pretty good.

Loving this Mello Marla Cream Cleanser!! I love a cream cleanser to take the dirt and cleanse the day away without stripping my skin of the natural oils- this does all that beautifully! It's gentle enough on my sensitive skin, but still removes everything nicely. Def expensive but it's a great product, 4 stars for the price! Gifted by drunk elephant

Drunk Elephant's Cream Cleanser is my holy grail! It's creamy, gentle, and leaves my skin hydrated and refreshed without feeling stripped. I love how it pampers my skin while being free of harsh ingredients! I was gifted by drunk elephant
Love how the cleanser smells! The cleanser lightly foams enough to clean impurities. When I rinse and dry my face it doesn't feel stripped or irritated. Great for all skin types!

avis.titre: I would definitely by when it's out
avis.texte: Love this face wash. Also the packaging is cute. I love the top and I love how easy to use it is in the shower. It's hydrating and doesn't strip my skin of my natural oils. It feels super nice on the skin and doesn't break me out at all. Gifted by drunk elephant.

Kindly gifted by drunk elephant — This cleanser is definitely a new favorite. I haven't experienced any breakouts or excessive dryness using this gentle cleanser. It removes makeup quite well without drying out my skin, and it is incredibly nourishing and moisturizing.

I really enjoy this cleanser because it is very gentle on the skin. I'm very careful with using products to not disrupt my skin barrier and I feel like it's been helping with fortifying it especially because it is so gentle even for sensitive skin. It's winter time now so it's been an incredible cleanser to use as it doesn't dry out my face afterwards. Very creamy and easy to use. Gifted by drunkelephant

I recently got this cleanser, gifted by Drunk Elephant and I'm so glad I've had the opportunity to try it out! It is such an impressive face cleanser! I'm impressed how easily this product rids my skin of all makeup, oil, and dirt from the day, including stubborn eye makeup!

As someone who already uses a drunk elephant cleanser I was excited to try this new release. I loved how gentle and effective this cleanser is. Gifted by drunkelephant

I loved the face butter drunk elephant gifted to me .so I had to get the cleanser. This felt like clouds on my face. Very hydrating even after rinsing it off. It lathered so well and a little bit goes a long way. It smells refreshing.

I was gifted by Drunk Elephant the Mello Marula Cream Cleanser and it has been my favorite cleanser! This cleanser is so good, it's become my every day cleanser! It's creamy and gentle but does foam up into a slight lather. It's not drying at all to my already dry skin and leaves me clean it's a repurchase for me! Gifted by drunkelephant

Perfect balanced cleanser! As a dry skin girl I am always on the hunt for a cleanser that leaves my skin feeling both clean and hydrated. This cleanser does just that and has quickly become a favorite of mine! Gifted by drunkelephant

This cleanser is super gentle on my skin and does wonders removing makeup. It takes away even water proof mascara. I like that it doesn't strip away skin natural oils and makes my skin smoother and doesn't dry out. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

Gifted by Drunk Elephant, this cleanser is different from what I have seen! My skin feels more refreshed after that splash of cold water, and less puffy! I have combination skin and some pores so I'm excited to see the finished results!

Love this gentle cleanser! I use it daily to remove my sunscreen and makeup. It removes all base makeup easily without residue. Highly recommended to try for sensitive skin like mine. Complimentary from drunk elephant.

I've been using the cream cleaner that was gifted to me by Drunk Elephant and it has become one of my favorites. I've been using it for over a week now and have seen overall improvement on my dry skin. Definitely will be trying more of their products.

I am really liking the cleanser. I use it as a my second step in double cleansing at night. My skin is sensitive and the cleanser its actually perfect because its soothing. The formula is good and cream like. Gifted by drunkelephant.

Love how gentle and nice it feels on my sensitive dry skin. It cleans without over drying and the texture is really creamy. The skin feels clean and soft and it smells delicious. Strongly recommend this cleanser. Received this complimentary from Drunk Elephant.

Gifted by drunk elephant - I am already Such a big fan of the brand I use so many products from their line. I have to say this is probably going to be one of my favorite products. It is so gentle on the skin and I'm loving it so much so far.

Complimentary from Drunk Elephant. This cream cleanser is gentle yet effective. It removes makeup well and skin feels cleansed. The formula is hydrating as well as easy to use. Overall, it leaves your skin feeling clean, soft, and hydrated.
